subject: prd/implementation-verification
statement: When re-invoked on the same workspace after a change with an unchanged manifest and baseline, the harness shall re-verify incrementally — the previously-failed rung first, work whose inputs are provably unchanged not repeated; a changed manifest or baseline invalidates incremental state and the next run is full.
rationale: fix cycles dominate the loop; re-running the world per fix is the cost this feature exists to remove — but never at the price of verifying against stale bindings
fit_criterion: on the fixture fix-cycle, re-verification executes strictly fewer verb runs than the initial full ladder; the changed-manifest fixture re-runs the full ladder; on the dogfood repo, p50 re-verification wall-time ≤ 50% of full-ladder time (M3)
